unsupported_layers.pedestrian_sidewalks: SACOG class1 multi-use paths are supported; comprehensive sidewalks, crossings, ADA condition and campus access rights remain unverified.
unsupported_layers.terrain_contours: Discrete DEM samples are supported; no interpolated contours, engineered slopes, flood elevations or excavation model generated.
unsupported_layers.transit_service: Stops from dated GTFS are supported; no claimed trip frequency, live service, accessible transfer path or campus stop connection.
